system.story: The archetypal blaster - a living blaze that burns everything it touches.

description.value:
Subclass: Pyromancer (Fire & destruction). The archetypal blaster and the most aggressive, lowest-control Elementalist.

Role Feature - Burn On

Bonus to rolled fire/energy damage; your signatures lean toward raw damage and area, and your fire abilities burn on - a small lingering-damage rider on targets you hit.

Signature Summon

A fire elemental - a living blaze: high damage, fragile.

Corp Records

Combustion-thaumic specialist.
